subject: general
question:
Which of the following pairs of Government Scheme and its associated Nodal Ministry/Department is correctly matched?

1. PM-AASHA - Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

2. e-NAM - Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

3. PMKSY - Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation

4. RODTEP - Ministry of Finance
solution:
The correct answer is __**e-NAM - Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)** is an online trading platform developed to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
 
• It is spearheaded by the **Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare**, aiming to connect farmers, traders, and buyers digitally.
 
• e-NAM was launched by the Government of India on **14th April 2016** as a major step towards agricultural reforms.
 
• The platform facilitates better price discovery through transparent auction processes and eliminates intermediaries, benefiting farmers directly.
 
• As of October 2023, e-NAM has integrated over **1,000 mandis** across India, enhancing the efficiency of agricultural marketing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PM-AASHA - Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution**

 
 
• PM-AASHA (Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan) is a scheme launched in 2018 aimed at ensuring remunerative prices for farmers' produce.
 
• It comprises three components: **Price Support Scheme (PSS)**, **Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS)**, and **Pilot of Private Procurement and Stockist Scheme (PPPS)**.
 
• However, the nodal ministry for PM-AASHA is the **Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare**, not the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution.
 
 
 
• **PMKSY - Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation**
 
 
• Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) aims to improve irrigation efficiency and increase agricultural productivity.
 
• The nodal ministry for PMKSY is the **Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare**, not the Ministry of Water Resources.
 
• It includes components such as **Accelerated Irrigation Benefit Programme (AIBP)** and **Har Khet Ko Pani**.
 
 
 
• **RODTEP - Ministry of Finance**
 
 
• Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (RODTEP) is a scheme launched in January 2021 to boost exports by reimbursing taxes and duties incurred during manufacturing and transport.
 
• The nodal ministry for RODTEP is the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**, not the Ministry of Finance.
 
• It replaced the earlier **MEIS (Merchandise Exports from India Scheme)** to align with World Trade Organization (WTO) rules.
